verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no API reference, developer docs or runnable examples. It shows only portal tips, OHID sign-in and tax-service pages, and the probes found ohiosos.gov and the filing portal returning 403 even at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
